title: Coplanarity inference of the purine skeleton
instruction: Observe the purine bicyclic skeleton. Determine: (a) whether all 14 heavy atoms are strictly coplanar; (b) which H atoms must deviate from that principal plane, and the order of magnitude of the deviation. Answer using the viewer only — no source files, no metadata.

title: Bond length vs perspective distance estimation
instruction: Estimate the 3D straight-line distance between the two carbonyl oxygens and its ratio to the length of the only C-C skeleton bond (C4-C5). Note whether caffeine contains any sp3-sp3 C-C single bond. Answer using the viewer only.

title: Segment self-occluded atoms at the current view
instruction: At the current camera view, precisely segment all H and C atoms that are partially occluded (self-occlusion) by front atoms/bonds. List the occluded H atoms and C atoms. Answer using the viewer only.

title: 3D rotation and occlusion prediction
instruction: Flip the entire 3D model 90 degrees backward about the horizontal (X) axis of the current view. Predict which atoms currently clearly visible will become fully occluded by the front bicyclic structure after the flip. Answer using the viewer only.
